ruleset.name: Naming Rules
ruleset.description: The Naming Ruleset contains a collection of rules about names - too long, too short, and so forth. Rust behavior: docs/naming.md.

rule.name: ShortClassName
rule.message: Avoid types with short names like {0}. Configured minimum length is {1}.
rule.description: Detects when structs, enums, traits, or unions have a very short name.

property.name: minimum
property.description: The type name length reporting threshold

property.name: exceptions
property.description: Comma-separated list of exceptions. Example: Id,Io,Db

rule.name: LongClassName
rule.message: Avoid excessively long type names like {0}. Keep type name length under {1}.
rule.description: Detects when structs, enums, traits, or unions are declared with excessively long names.

property.name: maximum
property.description: The type name length reporting threshold

property.name: subtract-prefixes
property.description: Comma-separated list of prefixes that will not count in the length of the type name. Only the first matching prefix will be subtracted.

property.name: subtract-suffixes
property.description: Comma-separated list of suffixes that will not count in the length of the type name. Only the first matching suffix will be subtracted.

rule.name: ShortVariable
rule.message: Avoid variables with short names like {0}. Configured minimum length is {1}.
rule.description: Detects when a field, local, or parameter has a very short name. For-loop and while-let binders are skipped (Rust analogue of phpmd's for-initializer skip).

property.name: minimum
property.description: Minimum length for a variable, field or parameter name

rule.name: LongVariable
rule.message: Avoid excessively long variable names like {0}. Keep variable name length under {1}.
rule.description: Detects when a field, formal or local variable is declared with a long name.

property.name: subtract-prefixes
property.description: Comma-separated list of prefixes that will not count in the length of the variable name. Only the first matching prefix will be subtracted.

property.name: subtract-suffixes
property.description: Comma-separated list of suffixes that will not count in the length of the variable name. Only the first matching suffix will be subtracted.

rule.name: ShortMethodName
rule.message: Avoid using short method names like {0}::{1}(). The configured minimum method name length is {2}.
rule.description: Detects when very short function or method names are used.

property.name: minimum
property.description: Minimum length for a method or function name

rule.name: ConstantNamingConventions
rule.message: Constant {0} should be defined in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE
rule.description: Const and static names should follow the configured naming convention. The default convention is upper (SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE), matching Rust idioms and clippy's non_upper_case_globals. Set convention=pascal for PascalCase (no underscores).

property.name: convention
property.description: Naming convention: upper (default, SCREAMING_SNAKE) or pascal (PascalCase)

rule.example: const MY_NUM: i32 = 0; // ok (upper) const badName: i32 = 1; // fail

rule.name: BooleanGetMethodName
rule.message: The '{0}()' method which returns a boolean should be named 'is_...()' or 'has_...()'
rule.description: Looks for functions or methods named get_... / Get... with bool as the return type. Rust convention prefers is_... or has_....

property.name: checkParameterizedMethods
property.description: When true, also check get_... methods that take parameters
